reason: The R8 fee is nothing to me, but an app that only launches on 1 November has zero reviews and no real photos from people who've been, and I don't book anything blind. I'll keep using Quicket or Computicket, or book with the host directly, until other people have tried it first.
objection: Is my money actually safe with a brand-new app I've never heard of? Saying TradeSafe holds it sounds good, but I've got no proof yet that refunds really come through when a host cancels.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few months of real reviews and photos from people who booked through TROVE, especially someone who got their money back when a host cancelled.
